cohort: 965 neonates born at or after 37 weeks' gestation delivered by cesarean section
finding: Antenatal oxytocin exposure was associated with a significant reduction in neonatal respiratory morbidity in neonates born by elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonatal respiratory morbidity associated with elective cesarean section was significantly reduced in neonates exposed to antenatal oxytocin.
